title: Read a position
summary: R: Read a position. Read pets[1]. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: Square brackets select values. Position 2 is the second item in R.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
R positions start at 1. pets[2] reads dog.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Index zero gives an empty selection, not the first item.
